idea-plugin.name: Vernac
idea-plugin.description:
Domain-Driven Design for Java, expressed in Vernac.

Vernac is a domain-specific language for defining typed identifiers, value objects, aggregates, repositories, ports, and use cases. Its compiler generates Java code following consistent architectural conventions, while custom business logic remains Java.

Editor features

  • Automatic recognition of .vernac files
  • Semantic highlighting
  • Syntax and semantic diagnostics
  • Code completion and snippets
  • Hover documentation
  • Go to Declaration for definitions within Vernac

Getting started

Open a .vernac file to activate language support. The Vernac language server is bundled with this plugin and starts automatically. No separate language server installation or LSP4IJ configuration is required.

To generate Java sources, configure the Vernac Maven plugin in your project. This IDE plugin provides editor support; code generation runs through your Maven build.

Project status

Vernac is under active development. Language syntax and generated APIs may change between releases.
